messages:
sara_finance: Heads up — noticed a cluster of promo credits didn't reduce the EU Dedicated invoice line. Put it on my radar while I grab the billing export.

michael_infra: thanks, can you paste the invoice id/period? I want to check mapping to reserved pools.

sara_finance: invoice: INV-2025-11-EU-7642, period: 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30. Quick excerpt from the export: 
```
account_id,project,charge_type,amount,coupon_applied
cust-741,redwood-eu,dedicated_gpu,11873.42,NO
cust-741,redwood-eu,hosted_api,213.11,YES
```

michael_infra: looks like coupon_applied is NO for the dedicated_gpu line. Could be because credits were scoped to `compute:reserved` rather than `compute:dedicated` in the mapping rules.

billing-bot: Automated check: Promo credits issued (PR-9876) scoped to resource_label:gpu-reserve-pool not to billing_line_item_type:dedicated_gpu. See mapping docs: https://billing.internal.redwood/credit-mapping

lee_sales: client flagged they had active promo credits and expected them to offset committed usage. They were told credits apply to all GPU spend. :frowning: What is the rollback plan?

ana_support: @lee_sales can you forward the customer's promo code? I want to verify grant scope. If it's a contract credit we might be able to do a retro apply.

lee_sales: sent in DM — code PROMO-EU-2025-40. Customer says it was part of the sales credit bundle for EU dedicated onboarding.

michael_infra: quick repro query I ran on the ledger export — credits have label `scope=reserve_queue` whereas invoices reference `line_item=dedicated_gpu`. Our billing pipeline doesn't join those labels. Snippet of the join I used:
```
SELECT l.invoice_id, l.line_item_type, c.code, c.scope FROM ledger l
LEFT JOIN credits c ON l.account_id = c.account_id
WHERE l.invoice_id = 'INV-2025-11-EU-7642';
```

sara_finance: ok, two follow-ups: 1) Can infra/billing patch the mapping rule so future credits map to dedicated lines? 2) Finance requests a retro-credit apply for the November invoice while we sort mapping.

michael_infra: I can add a transient rule to map `reserve_queue` -> `dedicated_gpu` for EU region today. Will need billing team's sign-off to retro-apply. Estimated dev time: 2-3 hours, plus a manual backfill job.

billing-bot: Actionable: create ticket BILL-4392 with labels [retro-credits][eu][dedicated]. Suggested runbook: 1) patch mapper, 2) run backfill join for affected invoices, 3) generate credit memos.

ana_support: filed BILL-4392 and emailed finance + legal about memos. Tagging @sara_finance for approvals.

lee_sales: customer notified that we're investigating and expect a credit memo in ~3 business days. They appreciate the fast response. :thumbsup:

sara_finance: thanks everyone. Can michael_infra paste the exact SQL or script you run here once you have it so we can keep an audit trail?

michael_infra: will do. Posting the backfill snippet when I run it: 
```
# backfill credits to dedicated lines (dry-run)
python tools/billing_backfill.py --invoice INV-2025-11-EU-7642 --credit-code PROMO-EU-2025-40 --scope-map reserve_queue:dedicated_gpu --dry-run
```

billing-bot: Dry-run complete — matches 1 invoice, expected credit amount: 11,873.42 EUR. Awaiting manual approval to apply.

sara_finance: approving retro apply. finance approves the credit memo. Please proceed after final QA.

michael_infra: starting the apply now. I'll post results and the final SQL.

billing-bot: Completed: credit memo CM-2025-11-741 created, invoice adjusted. All changes logged in BILL-4392.

sara_finance: resolved for November. We'll add a unit test to the billing mapper to catch future scope mismatches. Follow-up: schedule a postmortem next week to update docs and sales runbooks.
